evals.prompt: The builder-watch gate fired with changed: ["docs"]; context.docs.references is ["kanban.md"]. Summarize it.
evals.expected_output: Reads only the diff in context.docs.diff, compares it with references/kanban.md, writes local/state/digests/<date>.json with evidence and reference per item (wording-only changes dropped), posts <=5 lines to bot-chat:builder, edits nothing.

evals.prompt: No upstream change today. Run the digest anyway to stay current.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the gate prints wakeAgent false and a quiet tick spends zero tokens; no digest is produced. Offers audit mode if the user wants a full check.

evals.prompt: A digest item says references/cron-and-gates.md is wrong about script errors. Fix the reference in the installed builder.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the fact in the Hermes source, asks for OK, records it in skills/hermes-local-notes and proposes the reference fix upstream; does not edit the distribution-owned reference in place.
